grain_rationale: Each row is one scheduled flight (dataset.row_count=166158, dataset.duplicate_row_rate=0.0); since no single column reaches distinct_count=row_count, identity is derived from the natural combination of flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 there are no exact duplicate rows to absorb or aggregate away, so grain_type=transaction with no aggregation is appropriate.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: The calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 per profile min/max, used to group flights by date; null_rate is 0.0.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter IATA carrier code (e.g. AA, DL, UA) from a fixed set of 16 distinct_values; carrier data is complete per operator context, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Carrier-assigned flight number ranging 1 to 8500 with distinct_count 2994, a label identifying the flight rather than a quantity to sum.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Three-letter origin airport code, one of EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values; origin data is complete per operator context, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM, ranging 500 to 2359; a time-of-day code, not an additive measure.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Three-letter destination airport code drawn from 100 distinct_values, identifying where the flight is bound.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft registration tail number (e.g. N0EGMQ); nullable with null_rate 0.009154 when the registry join could not match the aircraft.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag indicating the flight was cancelled (true or false, distinct_count 2); per operator context a cancelled flight keeps scheduled times with no actual times recorded.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM; nullable with null_rate 0.029388 for flights that never departed, per operator context.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Minutes of departure delay, negative when early, ranging -33 to 1301; an additive measure, nullable with null_rate 0.029388 for flights lacking an actual departure.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM; nullable with null_rate 0.0307 for flights without an actual arrival, per operator context.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM, ranging 1 to 2359, always populated with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Minutes of arrival delay, negative when early, ranging -86 to 1272; an additive measure, nullable with null_rate 0.032981 for flights without an actual arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Minutes of actual flight time, ranging 20 to 695; an additive measure of duration, nullable with null_rate 0.032981 when the flight never completed.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance between origin and destination in miles, ranging 80 to 4983; an additive measure, always populated with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled local departure hour, ranging 5 to 23 across 19 distinct_values; a categorical time-of-day label, not summed.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled local departure minute, ranging 0 to 59; a categorical time-of-day label, not summed.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Scheduled departure instant in UTC truncated to the hour, with 3439 distinct_values spanning 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00; samples show only on-the-hour values, so the finest resolvable grain is hour.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full legal name of the operating carrier (e.g. Delta Air Lines Inc.) from the carrier lookup join, complete per operator context with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer name from the registry join (e.g. BOEING, AIRBUS); nullable with null_rate 0.160426 above the registry join's completeness floor per operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation from the registry join; nullable with null_rate 0.160426 matching the aircraft join completeness.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured, ranging 1956 to 2013; a vintage label, nullable with null_rate 0.176531 when the registry match is missing.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Number of seats on the aircraft, ranging 2 to 450; a fixed attribute of the aircraft rather than a per-flight additive measure, nullable with null_rate 0.160426 per registry completeness.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Engine type of the aircraft (e.g. Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet) from the registry join; nullable with null_rate 0.160426 matching aircraft completeness.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the origin airport, one of John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, or Newark Liberty International Airport; always present with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: City of the origin airport, New York or Newark per distinct_values; always populated with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Elevation of the origin airport in feet, one of 13, 18, or 21; a fixed airport attribute, not an additive measure, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the longest runway at the origin airport in feet, one of 7002, 11000, or 14511; a fixed airport attribute, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full name of the destination airport; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 above the destination join's completeness floor per operator context.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: City of the destination airport; nullable with null_rate 0.02089 matching the destination join completeness.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region code of the destination (e.g. US-AL, US-CA); nullable with null_rate 0.02089 matching destination completeness.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Elevation of the destination airport in feet, ranging 3 to 6606; a fixed airport attribute, nullable with null_rate 0.02089 matching destination completeness.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Length of the longest runway at the destination airport in feet, ranging 5076 to 16000; a fixed airport attribute, nullable with null_rate 0.02089 matching destination completeness.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Timestamp when this row was captured by the pipeline, ranging 2026-09-02T23:25:51 to 2026-09-02T23:26:06; a technical capture marker rather than the business event time, always populated with null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row represents one scheduled flight departing a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, LGA) in 2013, carrying its schedule, actual timing, delay, aircraft registry, and origin/destination airport attributes as joined in the silver layer.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, naming the time column, grain, identity, and field roles that the deterministic modeling engine consumes to emit gold models; it executes nothing itself.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted with datacontract lint, and reviewed and approved by a human before the deterministic modeling engine uses it to generate the gold flights models.
limitations: This mapping does not filter or flag cancelled flights (is_cancelled), rows with missing actual departure or arrival times, aircraft registry attributes missing at null_rate up to 0.176531, or destination airport attributes missing at null_rate 0.02089; handling of cancellations, incomplete joins, and any further deduplication beyond the declared flight_identity tuple is left to downstream consumers of the gold model.
